headers.value: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

ignoreCommand: [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs-site' ':(exclude).github' || exit 1
